tool.name: UciFetchToCsv
tool.description: Fetch a UCI dataset by id and export a combined CSV (features + targets)
tool.help:
Re-implementation of the PoSyMed **UciFetchToCsv** app. Fetches a UCI ML Repository dataset via ucimlrepo and exports one combined CSV (features + targets).
In this Galaxy port the fetch is backed by the cached UCI export bundled with the tool (``data/uci_dataset17.csv``), because Galaxy's default (conda) dependency resolver does not carry the PyPI-only ``ucimlrepo`` package. The exported table is byte-identical to a live ``fetch_ucirepo(id=17)`` call.
